vibe: Premium SaaS, Linear/Stripe/HubSpot inspired. High contrast, highly functional, beautiful micro-interactions, dark & light mode.

hierarchy.H1_Hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-black

rules: Use 'tracking-[0.2em]' and uppercase for tiny labels/overlines.
Never center text by default. Left-align paragraphs, inputs, labels, and dense content.
Color is Function Only. 95% of the UI should be monochrome. Color exists only to guide action.
Tint neutral greys slightly with blue (cool) or orange (warm) to make them feel alive.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers, dropdowns, or overlays. ALWAYS use a solid color or heavy backdrop blur.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders and Flat Solid structures. 1px subtle borders (border-border/40) for dashboard cards and data tables. Never rely purely on shadows for separation.
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness. Max 8px border-radius (rounded-md to rounded-lg). Nested radii must be smaller than parent.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Use layered, crisp shadows. No muddy generic shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for sticky headers/floating navs. Must use heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl) + high opacity background (bg-white/70 or bg-black/60) + 1px delicate inner stroke.

rules: Override default stretch behavior with align-items: start where necessary.
Ensure grid children are direct children. No wrapper divs that break grid structure.

layouts.spacing_scale: p-1, p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16. Use generous spacing (2-3x typical AI padding).
layouts.cards: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align lists, tabular data, and forms.
layouts.navigation: Sidebar layout for dashboards (w-64 to w-72). Must have visible navigation on desktop, never hidden behind a hamburger.

motion.micro_animations: Hover states (translate-y-[-2px]), crisp focus rings, active press scales (scale-95).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-transform, transition-opacity, transition-colors duration-200 ease-out).
motion.banned: NEVER use 'transition: all'. This breaks transforms.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI for tables, calendars, dropdowns, dialogs, tabs. Customize radius and borders for a sharp, Linear-esque feel.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox. NO native html inputs.
components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn Chart components for dashboard metrics.
components.icons: lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react. Do not use AI emojis.
components.toasts: Use 'sonner' for toasts. Component located at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for text below 18px. Minimum 3:1 for large text and interactive elements.
accessibility.focus_states: Must have higher contrast than default state (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Example: data-testid='login-form-submit-button'.

media.constraints: Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile devices.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) combined with semi-transparent solid backgrounds.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. This is a React project using .js/.jsx files (NOT TypeScript/.tsx). Configure all Shadcn components and logic accordingly.
2. Integrate 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'Satoshi' fonts in your global CSS or Tailwind config.
3. Set up the Tailwind configuration with the defined Swiss & High-Contrast color palette (base, surface, accent, text).
4. Build the modular layout: A persistent left sidebar (w-64) containing navigation links for Dashboard, CRM, Sales, Finance, HR, AI Assistant, etc.
5. Ensure the header contains a multi-tenant workspace switcher, a dark/light mode toggle, and the user's profile avatar.
6. Build the Dashboard view first: high-density grid for KPI cards (revenue, expenses, active clients), followed by charting components (Recharts) and an activity feed.
7. Construct the Client Management and Sales Pipeline (Kanban board) using Shadcn components.
8. Implement robust 'data-testid' attributes on ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, dropdowns, links).
9. Never use native HTML elements for complex inputs (use Shadcn Select, Dialog, Calendar).
10. Verify dark and light mode contrasts thoroughly to ensure premium enterprise readability.
